name: Cheesy Shrimp "Enchilada" Bake with Zucchini & Bell Pepper

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a medium saucepan over medium-high heat. Once the pan is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom; add flour and cook, whisking constantly, until lightly golden, about 1 minute.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
3 tbsp all-purpose flour

instructions.primary_message: Slowly whisk in tomato sauce, broth, and spices. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer until thickened, 5-6 minutes. Remove enchilada sauce from heat and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 (213 ml) cans tomato sauce
355 ml chicken or vegetable broth
3 tbsp chili powder
1 ½ tsp cumin, ground
1 ½ tsp salt
¾ tsp oregano, dried

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 jalapeño peppers
3 red bell peppers
6 medium zucchini squash

instructions.primary_message: If using frozen shrimp, place them in a colander and run under cold water to thaw them slightly and remove any ice crystals. (If using fresh shrimp, skip this step.) Place the shrimp on a clean towel or paper towels and pat dry.
instructions.secondary_message: 1.02 kg raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen

instructions.primary_message: Quarter jalapeños lengthwise; seed and remove ribs with a spoon. Finely dice and place in a large bowl. (Be careful with jalapeños; do not touch your eyes and ensure you wash your hands after handling or wear gloves while preparing.)
Trim, seed, and small dice bell peppers. Trim and halve zucchini lengthwise, then slice crosswise into thin half-moons. Add both to the bowl with the jalapeño.
Peel, halve, and small dice onions; peel and mince garlic. Add both to the bowl with the veggies.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ medium yellow onions
3 cloves garlic

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom; add veggies and spices. Cook, stirring occasionally, until fork-tender, 6-7 minutes. (Reserve bowl for later use.)
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
1 ½ tbsp chili powder
1 ½ tsp salt
¾ tsp cumin, ground
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, preheat oven to broil on high and position the rack in the upper third of the oven.
Coarsely grate cheddar, place in the reserved bowl, and set aside.
Chop shrimp into small pieces. When the veggies are done, add shrimp to the skillet and cook, stirring occasionally, until opaque, 3-4 minutes.

While the shrimp cooks, using a clean cutting board, cut the cream cheese into small pieces. Add to the skillet and continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until melted and combined, 3-4 minutes more.
Meanwhile, slice tortillas into 2-inch long strips. Add to the skillet, along with the enchilada sauce, and stir to combine; remove from heat.
Transfer shrimp mixture to a large baking dish. Top with cheddar and place in the oven; broil until the cheese is melted and bubbly, 3-5 minutes.
To serve, divide enchilada bake between plates or bowls and enjoy!

line_items.ingredient_name: raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen
